summary: Amarc Resources filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing the September 10, 2026 closing of a fully subscribed CAD$20 million private placement. The company issued 20,000,000 common shares at CAD$1.00 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of CAD$20,000,000, with Agentis Capital Mining Partners acting as financial advisor. Proceeds fund JOY District exploration, working capital, project investigations, and the DUKE and IKE properties. Canadian securities law imposes a four-month-plus-one-day hold expiring January 10, 2027; shares are unregistered in the US. Routine financing, not a special situation; watch for use-of-proceeds detail and any control-block shifts.
